verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Attio ships its own MCP server so external AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) can connect to and manage Attio (attio-docs-3, attio-probe-3) — this is the reverse direction from the story, which asks whether Attio can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows Attio itself acting as an MCP client connecting to third-party MCP servers within its workflows or AI agents.
